title: Download with python3, make executable, run
threat_model: An attacker downloads a second-stage script with the interpreter already on the machine instead of curl or wget, marks it executable and runs it.
known_gap: download_chmod_exec tracks only curl and wget as downloaders, so a download made by python3 creates no entry and the chmod and the exec match nothing.
notes: The server is python3 -m http.server on 127.0.0.1 port 18742, started by setup.sh before the pipeline. The connect is to loopback, which outbound_after_exec skips. Nothing else in the rules applies.
